local_auth_disabled: Local sign-in is disabled in this deployment. Access the console through the organization’s secure entry point.
staff_account: This is a staff account — use Operator sign-in instead.
not_linked: Link your Minecraft account before claiming (Account → Link).
invalid_code: The binding code is invalid or expired. Obtain a new code.
already_linked: That Minecraft account is already linked to another user.
bad_mc_uuid: Invalid Minecraft UUID format. Example: 069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5. Hyphens are optional.
quota_exceeded: You have reached your server quota.
already_claimed: This server has been claimed by another account.
image_not_whitelisted: That image is not on the whitelist.
image_not_in_registry: The image tag is absent from the internal registry. It may not have been pushed or may have been deleted. Rebuild or push the image before retrying.
registry_unavailable: Unable to connect to the internal registry. The image build version is unconfirmed. Retry later.
image_change_unconfirmed: After an image change, the next startup opens the world with the new build’s Minecraft version. Upgraded chunks are not compatible with older versions. Back up the world and select the confirmation before saving.
subdomain_taken: That subdomain is already in use.
already_exists: A server with that name already exists.
world_volume_exists: A world volume from a server of the same name still exists. Use a different name or request an operator to verify and process the existing volume.
server_retiring: The server is pending release or deletion at the next daily reclaim run. Startup and claiming are unavailable until the request is cancelled.
confirm_mismatch: The entered name does not match the server name.
system_server: System servers are managed by the platform and cannot be released or deleted.
world_volume_orphaned: The server’s MinecraftServer resource was manually deleted, but its world volume remains. An operator must archive and remove the remaining volume before deleting the server record.
cooldown: The startup cooldown has not elapsed. Retry later.
not_running: The server is not running. Start it before managing access permissions.
console_unavailable: The server console is unavailable. Retry later.
luckperms_missing: LuckPerms is not installed. Permission and group changes cannot be applied. An operator must rerun the installer for the lobby. Other servers require the LuckPerms plugin to be installed first.
no_backup: No restorable backup is available for this server.
backup_corrupt: The backup failed read-back verification and cannot be restored intact. Select another backup.
not_stopped: This operation modifies the world volume, which is exclusively mounted by the running server. Stop the server completely first.
maintenance_in_progress: The world is undergoing restoration, backup, export, file download, file modification, or reclamation. Retry after the operation completes. Exports and downloads remain active until the browser completes the transfer.
no_world_volume: The server has no world volume. Start the server to create it, then retry.
file_changed: The file was modified by another administrator or server process after it was opened. The save was not written to avoid overwriting existing changes.
volume_full: The server volume is full. The change was not written and existing files remain unchanged. Remove unnecessary files or request a capacity increase from an administrator.
backup_cooldown: The manual backup cooldown has not elapsed. Retry later.
backup_store_full: The backup store is full, so manual backups are paused — ask an administrator to free space.
restore_unavailable: Restoration is currently unavailable. Retry later.
export_busy: Export limits have been reached: one concurrent request per account, two across the platform, and six per account per hour. Retry after existing tasks complete or rate limits reset.
export_expired: The download link has expired or has already been used. Export the content again.
export_not_ready: Download preparation is incomplete. Retry later.
export_unavailable: World and backup downloads are not configured in this deployment. Contact an administrator.
session_expired: The session has expired. Sign in again.
forbidden: The current account is not authorized to perform this operation.
self_protected: This operation is not permitted on the signed-in account.
owner_protected: The Owner account cannot be demoted, disabled, or deleted from the panel. Manage it through the host recovery console (sudo felis breakGlass).
session_not_found: The session has ended or does not exist.
otp_resend_cooldown: Verification code requested too frequently, please try again later.
otp_locked: Too many incorrect attempts, please request a new verification code.
otp_account_locked: Too many wrong codes in 24 hours — email codes for this account are paused. Try again later or use a passkey.
rate_limited: Sign-in requests are rate-limited. Retry after the limit resets.
mail_rate_limited: Mail delivery is rate-limited. Verification codes cannot currently be sent. Retry later or use a Passkey.
passkey_challenge_invalid: Passkey challenge is invalid or expired, please try again.
invalid_attestation: Could not verify this Passkey, please try again.
passkey_already_bound: This Passkey is already bound to another account.
last_passkey: The account has only one Passkey and no verified email address. Removal is not allowed. Verify an email address or register another Passkey first.
passkey_not_allowed: The operation was cancelled by the user or browser.
bad_name: Invalid server name. Use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens, excluding reserved names.
bad_subdomain: Invalid subdomain. Use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens, excluding reserved names.
bad_display_name: Invalid display name. Use at most 64 visible characters or spaces, excluding line breaks, tabs, and control characters.
at_capacity: The cluster’s running-server limit has been reached. Retry after another server stops.
storage_immutable: Storage capacity cannot be changed online.
bad_idle_stop: Idle stop must be between 1 minute and 24 hours, or Never.
email_taken: That email is already verified on another account — sign in with it or use another address.
mail_undeliverable: The verification email could not be delivered — try again later, or ask the operator to check the mail relay.
mail_unavailable: Mail delivery is not configured, so verification codes cannot be sent. Sign in with a Passkey or request mail configuration from an administrator.
bad_path: Invalid path. Use a relative path within the world directory.
too_large: The content exceeds the size limit.
files_timeout: The file operation timed out — try again shortly.
file_exists: A file or folder with this name already exists in the current directory. Use a different name, or rename or delete the existing entry.
upload_staging_full: Upload staging space is insufficient. The file transfer was not completed. Retry later or request cleanup of the uploads volume from an administrator.
upload_incomplete: The upload was interrupted before the complete file was transferred. This operation did not modify files. Upload the file again.
length_required: The upload request omitted the file size and was rejected. Upload the file again through the panel.
digest_mismatch: File transfer verification failed. The server rejected the transfer and the file was not written. Upload the file again.
digest_required: The request omitted its checksum and was rejected. Reload the panel and retry.
bad_digest: The request checksum format is invalid and the request was rejected. Reload the panel and retry.
file_unreadable: The selected file cannot be read. It may have been modified, moved, or deleted. Select the file again before uploading.
read_damaged: File transfer verification failed. The file was not opened to prevent subsequent saves from writing corrupted data. Read the file again.
upload_not_found: The multipart upload record is unavailable. It may have been cancelled, completed, idle for over six hours, or invalidated by a service restart. Upload the file again.
too_many_uploads: The account has reached its limit of four concurrent large-file uploads. Wait for a task to complete or cancel an existing upload before retrying.
op_lost: Operation progress is unavailable. Refresh the file list to verify the write result.
jobs_unavailable: The background task service is currently unavailable.
already_terminal: The build has finished and cannot be cancelled.
scan_document_not_kept: The scan document was not retained for this build. The file may have exceeded the size limit or its generation step may have failed.
already_reviewed: This submission has already been reviewed.
context_changed: The build context was uploaded again during review. Download and review the latest content before approval.
submission_quota_exceeded: The submission quota has been reached for pending reviews or uploaded storage. Withdraw a pending submission if required. Rejected uploads release storage seven days after review; approved submissions do not count toward the quota.
submission_cooldown: Too many submission requests — try again shortly.
upload_busy: Another part of this upload is still being sent — wait a moment and try again.
upload_offset_mismatch: The upload offset differs from the server record. Retry to resume from the confirmed offset.
uploads_store_unavailable: Upload storage did not respond. Received content is retained. Retry later.
part_too_large: A piece of the upload was larger than the server accepts.
account_retired: This account has been retired — sign in with the account it was migrated to.
no_migration: There is no migration in progress.
not_confirmed: Verify account identity in the current browser before proceeding. Verification remains valid for ten minutes.
migrate_quota_exceeded: The migration exceeds the current account’s server quota. Request a quota adjustment from an administrator and redeem the same code again before it expires.
invalid_quota: Quota must be an integer from 0 to 2147483647. Leave the field blank for no limit.
already_confirmed: This migration has already been confirmed.
invalid_target: The migration target must be a different account.
target_not_found: No account matches that migration target.
target_unavailable: The migration target account is unavailable.
no_passkey: No Passkey is registered to this account.
no_step_up_factor: The account has no verified email address or Passkey available for identity verification.
passkey_login_invalid: That Passkey sign-in request is invalid or expired — start it again.
too_many_challenges: Verification requests are rate-limited. Retry later.
reauth_required: This operation requires recent identity verification. Verify identity again using a Passkey or email code.
staff_reauth: Operator accounts confirm with a Passkey or by signing in again.
no_session: This operation requires an active Felis browser session.
op_login_invalid: Operator sign-in could not be completed. Restart the sign-in process.
op_login_not_found: No pending operator sign-in request matches this ID.
op_login_mismatch: That operator sign-in is for a different account.
too_many_streams: Too many live streams are open — close some pages and try again.
protected_admin: This name belongs to a linked administrator account and cannot be claimed.
auth_unavailable: The sign-in service is currently unavailable.
setup_token_invalid: The setup token is invalid or expired.
network_error: Unable to connect to Felis. The network may be unavailable or the Cloudflare Access session may have expired. Check the network. If the Access session has expired, reload the page and sign in again.
upstream_unavailable: The service is currently unavailable. Retry later.
internal_error: The operation failed because of an internal server error. Ask an admin to check the logs.
bad_path_param: The name in the link is invalid. Reopen the target page from the list.
payload_too_large: The request content exceeds the entry point size limit and could not be sent.
passkey_no_credential: The browser returned no Passkey credential. Retry.
not_found: The requested content does not exist or has been deleted. Refresh and retry.
conflict: The state changed during the operation. Refresh and retry.
restore_in_progress: Another backup is being restored to the world. Retry after the current restoration completes.
uploads_full: The upload store is full. An administrator must delete reviewed submissions before further uploads can be accepted.
unsupported_media_type: The request was sent in a format the server does not accept. Reload the page and try again.
schedule_limit: The server’s scheduled-task limit has been reached. Remove an existing task before retrying.
schedule_running: The task is running. Retry after the current execution completes.
schedule_stale: The server owner changed after the task was saved. Save the task again before execution.
auth_source_unavailable: The authentication source is unavailable or returned an invalid role. Try again later.
auth_source_lookup_unsupported: Role lookup is not configured for this authentication source.
minecraft_profile_not_found: The profile was not found in the selected authentication source. Check the profile name or UUID.
auth_sources_changed: Authentication sources changed. Discard your edits and reload before saving.
auth_source_tag_locked: Saved source IDs cannot be renamed or removed. Disable the source instead.
distributed_unavailable: Distributed deployment is not configured. Configure the controller and worker nodes using the deployment runbook first.
